meaning:
γναφεύς, -έως, ὁ, Ion. and κοινή form of Att. κναφεύς
(κνάπτω, to card wool), [in LXX for כָּבַס, 4Ki.18:17, Isa.7:3 36:2 * ;]
a fuller, cloth-dresser: Mrk.9:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
